thread:
maya: Quick q — can we standardize span.name for LLM calls? Proposal: `llm.request` for the top-level, and subspans like `llm.kv-cache`, `llm.toolcall`, etc. Thoughts?

sam: +1 on consistency. Concern: we need model/version in resource vs attribute. If we put model in the span name we lose easy filtering.

arjun: prefer model in attribute `model.name` and `model.variant`. Also add `model.quantized` bool.

lia: what about tokens? We should have `tokens.prompt`, `tokens.generated`, `tokens.total` as ints. Also `llm.cache.hit` boolean from the runtime.

maya: agreed. Draft attrs I threw together locally: 
```
span.name = "llm.request"
attributes: {
  "model.name": "rw-llama-70b",
  "model.version": "2026-03-01",
  "model.quantized": true,
  "tokens.prompt": 124,
  "tokens.generated": 312,
  "tokens.total": 436,
  "llm.cache.hit": false,
  "routing.policy": "latency-tier",
  "inference.device": "v100-8",
  "rollout.id": "canary-42"
}
```

sam: I worry about mixing top-level `model.*` vs `llm.model.*`. For exporters that join traces with resources, having `resource.service.name` + `llm.model.name` is clearer.

arjun: ok how about we standardize on `llm.model.name`, `llm.model.version`, `llm.model.quantized` to avoid collisions. Keep `tokens.*` as `llm.tokens.*`.

lia: exporters routing note: OTLP -> honeycomb for dev traces, OTLP -> bigquery for billing/aggregates. We should include `llm.cost.estimated_usd_per_request` for billing pipelines.

maya: important privacy point: DO NOT store raw prompt text in attributes. Add `llm.prompt_id` (sha256) and `llm.prompt_safety` enum (ok/flagged).

devops-bot: CI lint: attribute-key-len > 40 gives warning on this branch — leaving for now. :shrug: 

sam: sampling rules: sample 1/100 for prod by default but 100% when `error` is true or latency > 2s. Add `trace.sample_reason` ("error", "latency", "manual", "always").

arjun: dashboard queries I want in the RFC: tokens per model over time, cache hit % by model and rollout, p50/p95 latency by routing.policy, cost by customer-tier.

lia: retention proposal: 7d for raw traces that contain any PII flags, 90d for full traces aggregated by model, 365d for billing traces. We also need an archived-only tier for SOC audits.

maya: TL;DR: span.name = `llm.request`, attributes prefixed `llm.*` with explicit `llm.model.*`, `llm.tokens.*`, `llm.cache.*`, `llm.routing.*`, `llm.device`, `llm.rollout.*`, `llm.prompt_id` (hashed), and `llm.cost.*`. Will draft RFC with examples + exporter mapping + sampling rules. Posting link shortly. :+1:

arjun: please include suggested OTEL keys for automatic instrumentation in the runtime (we can provide a small helper lib).

sam: nits: prefer boolean keys as `true/false` (not strings) in examples so integrators know type.

maya: yep will do. Thanks everyone — I'll open the RFC and tag eng-telemetry and runtime teams.
